de: In the village of Znamensky on the evening of November 13, a teenager climbed onto the roof of an electric train car traveling along the route Krasnodar-Armavir, and was electrocuted. The victim with severe injuries was hospitalized in a children's regional hospital.

de: The government of the Chelyabinsk region sent to the Legislative Assembly and the Chamber of Control and Accounts a report on the budget execution of the territorial MOMS for January-September 2026: revenues amounted to 66.18 billion rubles, expenses - 63.47 billion.

de: In Perm, on the site of the demolished infectious diseases hospital within the borders of Revolution, Pushkin, Popov and Kuibyshev streets, Alexander Square was opened with an amphitheater, a playground and the first fountain in the city that creates a fog effect.
